title: Satisficing as competitive Bayesian weighting: a minimal model of goal-directed choice under an unattained target
abstract: arXiv:2611.07270v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Animals and humans often do not maximize; they act relative to goals (aspiration levels) that are frequently not yet met. How can a goal that is not (yet) realized organize choice? Deacon (2012) calls such absence-referenced organization \emph{ententional}, and Garc\'{i}a-Valdecasas and Deacon (2024) argue that ends are best understood as constraints rather than as particular states. We examine this idea in a minimal formal setting: Risk-sensitive Satisficing (RS), a bandit learning rule that values each action by its share of past trials multiplied by its surplus or shortfall relative to an aspiration level. We show that RS can be rewritten as a Bayesian-like estimator, Attention Competitive Bayes (ACB), in which the aspiration level is the prior mean of every action and the finite budget of trials sets how strongly evidence can override it. translated_title: 满足化作为竞争性贝叶斯加权：未达成目标下目标导向选择的最小模型
translated_abstract: 动物和人类往往并非进行最大化决策；它们相对于尚未实现的目标（抱负水平）而行动。一个尚未实现的目标如何组织选择行为？Deacon（2012）将这种以“缺失”为参照的组织方式称为“意向性的”（ententional），而 García-Valdecasas 与 Deacon（2024）则主张，目的最好被理解为约束而非特定状态。我们在一个最小化的形式化环境中考察这一思想：风险敏感满足化（RS），一种多臂老虎机学习规则，它以每个动作过去被试行的份额乘以其相对于抱负水平的盈余或缺口来评估该动作的价值。我们证明 RS 可以被改写为一个类贝叶斯估计器——注意力竞争贝叶斯（ACB），其中抱负水平充当每个动作的先验均值，而有限的试验预算决定了证据能在多大程度上覆盖这一先验。由此得出两个结论。第一，不再被采样的动作会被部分覆盖……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文证明“风险敏感满足化”这一多臂老虎机学习规则可等价改写为类贝叶斯估计器“注意力竞争贝叶斯（ACB）”——未达成的抱负水平充当所有动作的先验均值，有限试验预算决定证据覆盖先验的强度，从而给出了以未实现目标为参照的目标导向选择的最小形式化模型。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that risk-sensitive satisficing can be rewritten as a Bayesian-like estimator, Attention Competitive Bayes, in which the unattained aspiration level serves as the prior mean of every action—providing a minimal formal model of goal-directed choice organized by an absent target.
